title: Game no Tatsujin
overview:
And I will stand at the top.

Four great table games, now united with the strongest minds.

Game no Tatsujin collects four classic table games on one disc, each with its own computer opponent: mahjong, shogi, Place (a Reversi-style disc-flipping game) and renju (five in a row). Take on the computer at a range of difficulty levels, or play a friend.

- Mahjong from Chatnoir
- Shogi from Alpha-Beta
- Place and renju from Itsui
- 1 or 2 players
- Shuttle Mouse compatible
- Memory backup

そして私が、頂点に立つ。

4大テーブルゲームが最強の頭脳で今、ひとつに。
